changelog:
- FIXED FOR REAL: launcher input rebuilt with defense in depth — the v0.7.0 stuck-menu came from broken XR liveness checks (get_tracker() returns a name, never null) plus trigger float/bool mismatch; now fixed with controller lasers (both hands, trigger = click), hand-tracking pinch (fixed tracker lookup), NEW gaze fallback (look + trigger or 1.2s dwell) with auto-hint after 10s of no input, live input diagnostic line, and XR input telemetry sent to the crash relay
- NEW: AudioKit — every game now has fitting sound: 30 procedural sound effects + 11 original genre music loops (chiptune, horror, tropical, western, underwater, epic, lo-fi, carnival, sci-fi, folk), each of the 96 games mapped to its genre, plus menu music
- NEW: launcher upgrades — animated aurora background, one-line descriptions for all 96 games, favorites (star) + recently-played rows, search across games, big v0.8.0 version badge, prominent CHECK FOR UPDATES button
- Roomscale hardened: RoomKit audit clean, room-setup flow keeps friendly fallbacks; all 96 games keep wall/furniture anchors + morph skins
- Crash-log relay still wired (auto-upload on errors)
